English: Open Courtyard
A cleared patch of earth with simple boundaries, serving as the heart of the early sanctuary. Used for open-air rituals and gatherings.
Decorated Courtyard
Adorned with carvings, banners, and prayer stones
French: pilgrims gather here for teachings and blessings.

English: Stone Courtyard
Stone paving and low walls make this courtyard a more permanent and dignified gathering place for the faithful.
Cloistered Courtyard
Sheltered walkways and stone arcades surround the sacred yard, encouraging quiet reflection and learning.
Enclosed Sanctuary Yard
Tall walls and iron-bound gates protect the sacred grounds, where priests teach and pilgrims seek blessing.
Ornate Sanctuary Yard
Intricate mosaics, fountains, and shrines fill the yard, drawing scholars and devotees from afar.
Blessed Sanctuary Courtyard
A legendary site of miracles, the courtyard draws the devout and the learned alike, greatly empowering the temples influence.
Sanctified Courtyard
The entire courtyard is ritually blessed, imbuing the grounds with spiritual energy and attracting pilgrims in great numbers.
Grand Sanctuary Courtyard
Magnificent arches, rare statuary, and golden inlays mark this as one of the worlds most sacred temple courtyards.
Temple Courtyard
A legendary spiritual center, the Temple Courtyard is revered by all, radiating sanctity and power across the land.
